The evening was graced by Hon'ble Shri Gajendra Singh Shekhawat, Union Minister of Culture and Tourism, as Chief Guest, whose esteemed presence highlighted the importance of cultural diplomacy, tourism development and international cooperation. H.E. Shri Jayant N. Khobragade, Ambassador of India to Spain, Shri Alvaro Garcia Moreno, Deputy Head of Mission, Embassy of Spain in India, along with other international diplomatic representatives and distinguished guests, participated in the celebrations. Celebrating Indian Heritage and India-Spain Friendship The festival showcased India's rich cultural heritage through traditional handlooms, textiles, fashion presentations and artistic expression, promoting cultural exchange and international cooperation. The event was organised by NEIFT, under the leadership of Festival Director Shri Vikram Rai Medhi, with the support and participation of Elementum Group and other partners. H.E. Shri Jayant N. Khobragade, Ambassador of India to Spain, Shri Alvaro Garcia Moreno, Deputy Head of Mission, Embassy of Spain in India, along with other international diplomatic representatives and distinguished guests, participated in the celebrations.
